parsed.rationale: Three distinct production types — `HSBColor` (package `ColorPalette`, `Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift:31`), `AccentColor` (package `Wallpaper`, `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/ThemeColors.swift:62`), and `HSBOffset` (package `Wallpaper`, `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/ThemeColors.swift:198`) — all expose an exactly-duplicated `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` initializer. Introducing a protocol `HSBInitializable` with that initializer requirement in the `ColorPalette` package (which already owns the canonical HSB concept) lets all three types declare conformance and eliminates the repeated implementation. Because `Wallpaper` already depends on `ColorPalette` (it uses `HSBColor`), no new dependency edge is required. None of the records carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so this is live production duplication that warrants consolidation.
